Lucie Pssn  I know it depends on the PIBA branch you are appointed to.  It also depends on if they have all the documents they need, which country you are from etc. My israeli partner and I have applied in September last year, got a request to hand in the paperwork physically in December, but got delayed by some expired document and a missed e-mail. 

I have not been able to visit him in Israel since we applied but he is able to visit me in the Netherlands. 
I have heard others say that it can be a risk for your Israeli partner to visit you a lot. Especially if they stay for longer periods while you are in the middle of the visa process. But this is mostly because the Israeli sides 'center of life' needs to be Israel, which they can doubt if he is abroad a lot.  I don't know if this information is entirely correct, or if it applies to everyone so you should clarify this with someone.
